# Vaishnavi Jewels (Vaishnavi Gem & Jewel Pvt Ltd)

> Certified diamond jewellery made in Surat, India's diamond city, since 1 June 2005. Natural and lab-grown diamond jewellery, certified solitaire rings (each laser-inscribed with its IGI, EGL or TGL report number, verifiable online), bridal jewellery, mangalsutras and Polki. BIS HUID hallmarked gold. Made in our own manufacturing unit; free insured delivery to major Indian cities.

- Address: 120 & 220, Rajhans Ornate - High Street Retail Mall, Parle Point, Surat, Gujarat 395007, India
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 11 AM to 8 PM; closed Sunday
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 75674 00099
- Email: vaishnaviexim@gmail.com
- Founder: Shilpi Agarwal
- Customers across India, with many families from Ahmedabad, Vadodara and Mathura
